objective: Scale the completed minimal KV-cache RTL seed toward an LLM-serving-like paged-attention memory access pattern without claiming full paged attention or model-level inference.

previous_evidence.classification: State-parallel KV-cache states are materially faster; single-state repeated launches are slower.

why_this_next: It directly addresses the residual non-claim left by the completed minimal KV-cache goal: not full paged-attention implementation.
It keeps the active source surface smaller than importing a full model or full ITA MHA flow.
It can preserve the existing coverage-output ABI and CPU-vs-hybrid comparison machinery.
It tests a serving-relevant access pattern: logical token slots mapped through page table entries rather than a single fixed circular array.
required_rtl_behaviors: append into the current logical tail
prior logical slot read through the page table
page wrap or remap event counting
coverage-output words for append, read hit, page boundary, wrap/remap, and checksum behavior

planned_shapes.name: minimum_overhead_paged_kv_probe
planned_shapes.purpose: Smoke CPU/GPU launch and coverage-output equivalence for the paged KV-cache overlay.

planned_shapes.name: state_parallel_paged_kv_probe
planned_shapes.purpose: Check whether independent paged KV-cache states preserve the state-parallel speed class.

planned_shapes.name: single_state_repeated_paged_kv_probe
planned_shapes.purpose: Check whether repeated single-state launches remain the weak class.

planned_shapes.name: larger_state_parallel_paged_kv_probe
planned_shapes.purpose: Stress the page table and page-boundary counters with more independent states if the first three shapes pass.

result.classification: State-parallel 32x1 and 128x1 are materially faster on hybrid wall time; single-state repeated 1x32 is much weaker than many-state shapes because launch overhead is not amortized across independent states.

claim_scope: paged KV-cache RTL harness intake and first CPU-vs-hybrid benchmark definition only
non_claims: not low-precision or compressed KV cache
